name: French Press
instructions: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar or barbell with a narrow overhand grip, arms extended over your chest.
Bend only at the elbows, lowering the bar toward your forehead.
Keep the upper arms vertical and still throughout.
Extend the elbows to press back up. Also called a lying triceps extension or skull crusher.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: French Press is an intermediate pushing exercise for the triceps, performed with a barbell. Pressing strength keeps daily pushing tasks — and your shoulders — working well for decades.
